description: This is a C++ source file implementing a MaintenanceManager plugin for the WPEFramework. It manages maintenance activities, including handling events via IARM and Thunder interfaces, maintaining status, starting/stopping tasks, and interacting with various device-specific components. The code defines classes, methods, event handlers, and utility functions related to device maintenance operations.
